howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB. The page-count preview loads automatically.

howto.name: Choose split mode
howto.text: Pick 'Fixed range' to split every N pages, 'Custom ranges' to specify exact page numbers (e.g. 1-3, 7-10), or 'Extract every page' to get individual pages.

howto.name: Split and download
howto.text: Click Split. Each resulting PDF is packaged into a ZIP file for convenient downloading.

faq.q: Can I split a PDF into individual pages?
faq.a: Yes — pick the 'Extract every page' option to get every page as a separate PDF file, all packaged into a ZIP download. There is no cap on the number of pages.

faq.q: Can I extract non-consecutive pages like 1, 5, and 12?
faq.a: Yes. Switch to 'Custom ranges' and enter exact page numbers or ranges: e.g. `1, 5, 12` or `1-3, 12-15`. Each range becomes a separate PDF in the output ZIP.

faq.q: What happens to bookmarks and hyperlinks when I split?
faq.a: Bookmarks inside the extracted page range are preserved with adjusted page numbers. Bookmarks pointing outside the range are dropped. Internal hyperlinks to pages outside the range are removed; external hyperlinks are kept intact.

No. The split is non-destructive — the original is read, the output is written to a fresh file, and the input file is deleted from the server within minutes of the response. Your original on your device is untouched.

faq.q: Is my PDF uploaded to the cloud?
faq.a: It is uploaded to PrivaTools' own isolated container for processing, held in temporary per-request storage, then unlinked immediately. It is never kept in permanent storage, never inspected, never shared with any third party. The split logic is open source on GitHub for verification.

faq.q: What's the difference between Split, Split by Size, and Split by Bookmarks?
faq.a: Split lets you pick page ranges manually. Split by Size keeps each chunk under a target file size (e.g. 10 MB for email). Split by Bookmarks auto-splits at every chapter using the PDF's existing outline tree.
